parsed.title: Save a Favorite Message with Ad
parsed.oneLiner: Allow non-registered users to save favorite messages by watching a short game, increasing engagement without forcing signup.

newMechanic.name: Rewarded Favorite
newMechanic.description: Unlock individual favorite message saves without a full account.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Allows casual users to utilize the favorites feature without immediate friction of signup, lowering entry barriers.

parsed.trigger: User taps 'Favorite' on a message, and the 'Favorite messages' (s21) wall is triggered because they lack an account.
parsed.eligibility: Non-registered users only; users who have not yet signed up.

offer.title: Save to Favorites?
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with Luzia to save this message to your favorites for free.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Limits rewards to 3 saves per day, ensuring heavy users are still incentivized to create an account for unlimited storage; only available to non-registered users.

kpis.holdout: 10% of users excluded from rewarded path for 4 weeks.

risks: Users may find the 3-save limit restrictive and churn.
Lower perceived value of account signup.
